item.title: These movies have Texans googling for answers
item.description: A new study has identified "Donnie Darko" as the most confusing movie among fans in Texas, with an average of 1,728 monthly searches for plot and ending explanations.

item.title: Grand Prairie welcomes new social lounge and sports bar
item.description: Chef Tiffany Derry and Tom Foley have created The Landing, a new gastro pub and social lounge in Grand Prairie's EpicCentral entertainment district, featuring elevated comfort food, live entertainment, and sports bar energy, opening April 9.

item.title: Texas pulls off a massive comeback in 2026 fishing index
item.description: Texas has surged 23 places to rank seventh in the nation in the 2026 America's Best Fishing States Index, due to its top-tier infrastructure and high demand for both saltwater and freshwater fishing.

item.title: Ritz-Carlton Dallas hosts global wine dinner and Easter brunch
item.description: Fearing's Restaurant at The Ritz-Carlton, Dallas, will host a global wine dinner on March 26 and an Easter Brunch on April 5, both featuring international cuisine and family activities.

item.title: Young men in Texas actively seek hair loss solutions online
item.description: Texas ranks 11th nationally for hair loss concern and third for total search volume, with young men in their 20s being the most active demographic.

item.title: Cirque du Soleil's ECHO is in North Texas
item.description: Cirque du Soleil's ECHO is coming to North Texas from April 9 to May 3, 2026, telling a story of connection, intention, and the bond between humans and the animal kingdom.

item.title: Dallas Arboretum to host largest Hunt Slonem outdoor gallery
item.description: The Dallas Arboretum and Botanical Garden will host the largest outdoor gallery of artist Hunt Slonem's work ever produced, featuring 28 installations and more than 100 works of art from April 20 through Sept. 30.
